body.p: A fox came to a wolf's house, it said: "I'll fatten your reindeer within a month, give [them] to me, I'll guard the reindeers.[DCh]: Not clear why RFL.SG ar "oro-r-bi"; subject and possessor are different. When a month has passed, you'll go for them." The wolf gave its reindeers. The fox, [DCh]: The syntax is completely unclear.having led [them] away, ate the reindeers, it ate them all up. Eating he broke a tooth. When a month had passed, the wolf came. The fox saw [it], it ran to the wolf's house and said: "Grease my breast with tallow! Attach a bell to the tail." He ran off with the attached things. The fox found relatives, it began to live together [with them]. The wolf came, it came, it jumped over the bonfire, it burned its tail, the foxes started to laugh about the wolf. The wolf saw the broken tooth, it said: "Let us louse each other." They started to louse each other. The wolf stabbed [the fox], all foxes ran away.
